items.subject: Guided applicability-safe axial workflow
items.finding: The N2 parent had scalar axial functions but no guided 7.1/7.2 orchestration that suppresses inapplicable branches and preserves a stepwise trace.
items.remediation: Added standard_core.axial_workflows with solid and built-up guided routes plus schemas/examples.

items.subject: Current equation (7a) and gamma_res
items.finding: The N2 equation inventory/code did not contain the current rolled-I equation (7a) and its gamma_res rule.
items.remediation: Added SP16-EQ-007A, literal current-source gamma_res endpoint rules and Ry interpolation, plus boundary tests.

items.subject: NormCAD current equation (7a)
items.finding: The inspected historical NormCAD SP16 DSL contains the old 7.1.3 equation-(7) route but no current equation-(7a)/gamma_res branch.
items.remediation: NormCAD remains secondary evidence only; production follows the current SP16 source.

items.subject: Table 8 dispatch
items.finding: The legacy built-up runner could evaluate multiple Table 8 formula producers rather than selecting only the applicable section-type/connector branch.
items.remediation: selected_table8_effective_slenderness dispatches exactly one of equations (12)-(17).

items.subject: Table 8 minimum six-panel applicability
items.finding: Table 8 applies to members with at least six panels; a generic route must not silently apply it below six.
items.remediation: For panel_count<6, battens return an external frame-analysis requirement and lattice redirects to the 7.2.5 route/fails closed if required lambda_ef is not externally available.

items.subject: Phi cap at exact 3.8/4.4/5.8 boundary
items.finding: Clause 7.1.3 wording applies the 7.6/lambda_bar^2 cap at values above the thresholds, while exact printed Annex D.1 boundary nodes reflect capped values at some threshold nodes.
items.remediation: No silent normative rewrite. Formula workflow preserves the established exact-table-boundary policy and records the conflict explicitly; the source ambiguity remains visible in trace/evidence.

items.subject: NormCAD static Table 8 equation (14)
items.finding: The inspected NormCAD DSL expression for equation (14) uses a multiplicative term sequence under SQRT, whereas current SP16 Table 8 has lambda_max^2 + 0.82(1+3n3)lambda_b3^2.
items.remediation: Production formula (14) is source-based and independently tested; the historical NormCAD expression is not reused.

items.subject: Current-SP16 axial lambda_bar basis and Stage N3 nodes
items.finding: The pre-N3 graph had an SP554-context lambda_bar producer using Ryn, which must not be reused for current SP16 clause 7.1.3 where lambda_bar uses Ry.
items.remediation: DAG v0.3.32 adds a dedicated Stage N3 lambda_bar producer using Ry and explicit equation (7a), gamma_res, Table 8 and Qfic nodes.
